defects.description: Movie mode stopped before the emergent arc.
Tidegarden direct boot aliased seed-only volcanic terrain.
Connected co-op could neither route to p1 nor authoritatively persist the arc.
Replay could deadlock on stale Tidegarden Habitat receipts.
Crossing reload fabricated touchdown and egress.
Ship pose persistence and completed-site return were unwired.
Signed audiovisual contract had no production consumer.
Tidegarden habitat restore subscribed to its own revision writes and entered a React update loop after Core placement.
Low and Potato shader policy froze the surface gameplay day/night clock and prevented safe-rest progression.

A whole-rail Chapter 5-to-6 handoff could bounce off the pond lip because dry-ground step assist remained active during fluid entry and a camera-only readiness guard cleared fixed-step dive intent after material submersion.

Unsupported feet-only water contact with a dry eye and exhausted jetpack produced no meaningful swim blend, deadlocking wet-bank egress; a bounded shallow unsupported swim factor now preserves physical stroke authority.

A cached cross-face unreachable route with no waypoint survived after the body settled from unsupported to supported; material displacement and unsupported-to-supported contact now invalidate the cache while the local wet-egress leg is retained.

High-frequency local pose publication fed new React arrays to avatar and minimap subscribers and recursed to maximum update depth; frame-coalesced external-store notifications now expose stable full and remote-only snapshots.

EfficientScene routed continuous frame positions through React state while render-created debug adapters crossed a passive-effect boundary, creating a second maximum-depth path; a live position mailbox and stable debug callbacks remove the scene-position passive loop.

The official three-run POTATO mechanical gate passes 3/3; the quality-profile matrix, reduced-motion equivalence, supported headed input, real-GPU taste, and persistence evidence remain release gates.
Server does not independently regenerate support and water voxels.
Trusted server pose samples exist, but the server does not yet issue or validate embodied Story receipts for the physical Chapter 4-7 acts.
